_note: Crew diary entries for the thirteen days of the run (Thursday 15 to Tuesday 27 October 2026), keyed by mission day then by officer: 39 slots. Every slot ships as a PLACEHOLDER: an entry whose text begins with [PLACEHOLDER] is a slot to write into. Its first line is shown greyed on the public crew log, so the shape of the whole log is visible from the start; the 'Cue:' line after it is a prompt for the writer and is shown only in mission control. Replace the text — on the Crew log tab of mission control, on the officer's own tab, or here — and the entry is published for that day the moment it is saved. Saving an entry empty puts the placeholder back. Anything written live from mission control takes that slot over and is never replaced from this file, so you can write ahead here safely.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 001 · Thu 15 Oct · Science officer — to be written at the end of this day.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 001 · Thu 15 Oct · Health officer — to be written at the end of this day.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 002 · Fri 16 Oct · Science officer — to be written at the end of this day.

2.HEALTH OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 002 · Fri 16 Oct · Health officer — to be written at the end of this day.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 003 · Sat 17 Oct · Communication officer — to be written at the end of this day.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 003 · Sat 17 Oct · Science officer — to be written at the end of this day.

3.HEALTH OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 003 · Sat 17 Oct · Health officer — to be written at the end of this day.
Cue: The condensation as a health matter. The wipe-down, and a note on who is and is not unwell.

4.COMMUNICATION OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 004 · Sun 18 Oct · Communication officer — to be written at the end of this day.

4.SCIENCE OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 004 · Sun 18 Oct · Science officer — to be written at the end of this day.
Cue: Batch B collected, batch A under the scope a second time. Grain size, colour, the first thing that does not match the model.
4.HEALTH OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 004 · Sun 18 Oct · Health officer — to be written at the end of this day.
Cue: The routine has set. Sleep, appetite, temper on the fourth day — the slow signals, before anything goes wrong.

5.COMMUNICATION OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 005 · Mon 19 Oct · Communication officer — to be written at the end of this day.
Cue: Telling Earth about the water. The first message that came back with worry in it, and what the delay does to worry.
5.SCIENCE OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 005 · Mon 19 Oct · Science officer — to be written at the end of this day.
Cue: The recovery loop four per cent low since 02:00 and no cause found. Filter change brought forward; the dust load against the model; the first germination check.
5.HEALTH OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 005 · Mon 19 Oct · Health officer — to be written at the end of this day.
Cue: Water allowance cut at lunch. What reduced intake shows up as first, and when you will know if the new figure works.

6.COMMUNICATION OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 006 · Tue 20 Oct · Communication officer — to be written at the end of this day.
Cue: A window on a thirsty day. Which questions you answered fully and which you answered short.
6.SCIENCE OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 006 · Tue 20 Oct · Science officer — to be written at the end of this day.
Cue: Dust on the west panel, eleven per cent of the power, and what it looked like up close. Batch B under the scope.
6.HEALTH OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 006 · Tue 20 Oct · Health officer — to be written at the end of this day.
Cue: Second day on the reduced allowance. Conditioning on the reduced-water protocol; headaches, tempers, who is drinking less than their share.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 007 · Wed 21 Oct · Communication officer — to be written at the end of this day.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 007 · Wed 21 Oct · Science officer — to be written at the end of this day.

7.HEALTH OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 007 · Wed 21 Oct · Health officer — to be written at the end of this day.
Cue: Six days done, six to go. Grip, pulse, sleep across the crew. What the midpoint meal did that no metric records.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 008 · Thu 22 Oct · Communication officer — to be written at the end of this day.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 008 · Thu 22 Oct · Science officer — to be written at the end of this day.
Cue: The CO₂ number you do not like, and why — not danger, but what it says about the loop. The seal that failed a second time.
8.HEALTH OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 008 · Thu 22 Oct · Health officer — to be written at the end of this day.
Cue: The hard day you have been watching for. CO₂ in the sleep period, conditioning shortened, a medical kit opened, two hours you were not sure about.

9.COMMUNICATION OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 009 · Fri 23 Oct · Communication officer — to be written at the end of this day.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 009 · Fri 23 Oct · Science officer — to be written at the end of this day.

9.HEALTH OFFICER:
[PLACEHOLDER] Day 009 · Fri 23 Oct · Health officer — to be written at the end of this day.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 010 · Sat 24 Oct · Communication officer — to be written at the end of this day.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 010 · Sat 24 Oct · Science officer — to be written at the end of this day.
Cue: First harvest. The weight of it, split three ways, eaten at breakfast. The seal, third attempt. Tonight the clocks on Earth go back an hour.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 010 · Sat 24 Oct · Health officer — to be written at the end of this day.
Cue: Better. The loop repair, the harvest, the first full conditioning session since day seven — what those did to the crew that you can and cannot measure.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 011 · Sun 25 Oct · Communication officer — to be written at the end of this day.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 011 · Sun 25 Oct · Science officer — to be written at the end of this day.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 011 · Sun 25 Oct · Health officer — to be written at the end of this day.

[PLACEHOLDER] Day 012 · Mon 26 Oct · Health officer — to be written at the end of this day.
